key_patterns: Services return fpdart Either<Failure, T>; failures are subclasses of Failure in lib/core/errors/failure.dart (existing: WrongMagicWordFailure, BackupFormatFailure, MagicWordValidationFailure, BackupConflictFailure). BackupCodec.readHeaderOrNull(bytes) returns the header WITHOUT decrypting (used for encMode inspection). BackupService talks to DriveRepository (searchBackupFile/searchRootBackupFile/getBackupModifiedTime/downloadFile/uploadBackup/deleteFile) and MagicWordService (get/set/clear/hasMagicWord; normalize=trim+NFC; length 8-16). Tests use a FakeDriveRepository + FakeMagicWordService (in backup_service_test.dart) and MockAuthRepository/MockContactsRepository; ProviderContainer overrides wire them. The BackupReminderService reminder logic (no-contact -> no reminder) is ALREADY correct and MUST NOT be changed.
